source_text: He also announced that his delegation would be in Islamabad on Monday night. By Tuesday afternoon in Islamabad, no delegation has yet arrived. Yet the president has continued to sound optimistic about a deal.
translated_text: Ningĩ nĩ onanirie atĩ rũgano rwake rũgakorũo Islamabad ũtukũ wa Jumatatu.Kũrĩ hwaĩ-inĩ wa Kĩrũrũ gĩa Kerĩ Islamabad, gũtirĩ rũgano rũngĩorire.No mũtongoria wa bũrũri nĩatũũrĩte arĩ na mwĩhoko wa kũhingia kĩmenyithia kĩu.

source_text: It’s difficult to know how this series of carrots, sticks, self-praise and insults will be read by the Iranian delegation; negotiators from their side too have posted rebukes and their positions online and there will be some recognition that both the US and Iran will be often thinking of their own domestic audiences in their public messages.
translated_text: Nĩ ũndũ wa kĩyo kũmenya ũrĩa mũtaratara ũyũ wa karoti, mĩtĩ, kwĩgooca na kũruma ũgaathĩrĩrio nĩ rũrĩrĩ rwa Iran; o nao arũmĩrĩri a mũbango wa kũiguithania maũndũ nĩ marutĩte marũa ma gũkunyanĩra na mawoni mao intaneti-inĩ na nĩ magĩrĩire kũmenya atĩ Amerika na Iran nĩ igũthiĩ na mbere gwĩciria ũhoro wa andũ ao ene thĩinĩ wa ndũmĩrĩri ciao.

source_text: Yet there is little trust between the two sides with a risk of miscalculation.
translated_text: No kũrĩ na ũiguano mũnini gatagatĩ ka mabũrũri macio merĩ na mũgwati wa kũhĩtia.

source_text: Rarely has such delicate diplomacy been conducted with the backdrop of such instantaneous and volatile public messaging.
translated_text: Nĩ kaingĩ ũteti ũcio wa bata ũkoragwo ũrorete kũheana ndũmĩrĩri ya andũ othe na ihenya.
